# Public template fixtures

Exact `git archive --format=zip` exports from aibuild-lab/my-workbench-template.
Revision and tree identities, and the supported skill/mode hashes, are recorded
in scripts/enrollment_templates.json. These fixtures contain only public template
source. They are not course packages or independently admitted distributions.

- d89625d3ce99ee48f11d11c6186a39e227f93b37: audited Essentials template.
- 913cdf1819610666de51cbe34d5da90080280114: coordinated enrollment handoff PR.

Changing an archive alone cannot extend supported templates. Review the exact
source and update the installer-owned snapshot registry deliberately.
